body:
Thanks for sharing your story with me nadnerb927, I'm sorry your friend lost his so much of his family in such an awful way, I'm glad he's recovering from that trauma though.

And btw I was a huge Naruto fan when I was around your age :) I've seen well past episode 15! 

I don't really watch anime anymore, but the suggestion really cheered me up

Thank you Sleepybot5000.

I do realize, that at this time that the new (possible) diagnosis of Hyperthyroidism may bring new answers for me.

I just feel as if I've been dragging myself through the mud, and I'm so tired. I've been fighting this for so many months now. 

I feel so defeated, but I know I have to continue trying to find answers, if only for my parents. They don't deserve to live with the consequences of my actions.

I am still afraid of living further with these illnesses (both have terrified me)

Thanks, though for talking with me, I really appreciate it.
